notes.title: Update! Version 1.08
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.08 changelog [/b]
[list]
[*] Several localization tweaks, some typos fixed.
[*] Colonies are no longer needed to achieve victory and will not count towards Cities goal.
[*] Hotkeys for menus (1-5) and quick load (F6) added.
[*] Cities' on the world map relations after the Unification no longer depend on the turn Unification happened on.
[*] Fixed the bug with sudden resource drop after some war declarations.
[*] Starting relations changed for Antioch (8), London (7), and Attila's Camp (4).
[*] Screen fading for all windows made more transparent (stat panel is seen clearer now).
[*] Traders spawn rate increased for Athens (now every 10 turns, was 15) and Sparta (now every 15 turns, was 25)
[/list]

notes.title: Update! Version 1.07.
notes.notes:
We released a small update that makes Saves easier to work with.

[list]
[*] Saves are sorted by date: most recent first.
[*] Saves are recorded even if you forgot to press 'Save'.
[/list]

Have fun! :)

notes.title: Is Marble Age: Remastered worthy of a Steam Award Nomination?

Steam hosts thousands of amazing games made by dedicated developers from every corner of the world. notes.title: Update! Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Thank you to all of you who reported the bugs and issues you found in Marble Age: Remastered!

Here is what was fixed:
[list]
[*] Raids will no longer bring negative rewards.
[*] Classic Era quest will no longer start after the Trading race quest — instead, it will always appear on turn 130.
[*] You cannot sell the army indefinitely anymore (selling won't happen if you sell more army than you have).
[*] Locations can no longer have a negative number of workers on them.
[*] Fixed errors with the event queue showing messages out of order.
[*] Improved water effects.
[*] Fixed the incorrect city being shown during loadings.
[*] Fixed the building animation order and layers.
[*] Tooltips' size is improved for techs and buildings.
[*] Text appearance on Battle screen is improved.
[*] Localizations updated.
[*] Some texts fixed.
[/list]

[h3]Technologies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mechanic 1: building and upkeep cost is -20% (was -30%).
[*] Mechanic 2: building and upkeep cost is -30% (was -10%).
[*] Tyranny 1: upkeep cost is -20% (was -30%).
[*] Tyranny 1: upkeep cost is -30% (was -40%).
[/list]

Just a reminder: you're welcome to report bugs anytime on our Discord server or send us an email to support@clarusvictoria.com.

notes.title: Marble Age: Remastered Version 1.04
notes.notes:
Thanks to our amazing community we fixed another batch of bugs and added support for Brazilian Portuguese!

[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New effects for available and chosen techs\buildings, difficulties, and bonuses.
[*] Sliders can be moved by clicking now, not only dragging.
[*] Added achievements for every supported language.
[*] Added support for Brazilian Portuguese.
[*] Text fixes.
[*] Link to Instagram fixed.
[*] Fixed Rome icon showing on the map after it's subjugation.
[*] Bonus for learning every 2 Tier technology is removed.
[/list]

[h3]General balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Messina's trade bonus is changed - now it raises the profit from selling in the city.
[*] Sparta's starting resources changed - 100 Gold (was 50) and 0 Army (was 20).
[*] Improved the calculation of rewards and penalties from random events.
[*] Arabs and Hunns are now harder to beat on Easy difficulty.
[/list]

[h3]Bonuses:[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Rich copper mines" brings +20% Force of Army and production (was +25%).
[*] "Bloody sacrifices" reduce Population Growth by 10% (was 5%).
[*] "Fertile Soil" reduces the efficiency of mountain Production growth by 10% (was miners limit -10%).
[*] "Wide meadows" reduces the efficiency of mountain Production growth by 10% (was miners limit -10%).
[*] "Strong civilian reserves" reduces culture growth from sages by 10% (was all culture growth -10%).
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update 1.02 + 1.03
notes.notes:
[h3]Main[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed error with trade being cancelled while setting the number of fleet involved to the max.
[*] Better logic behind "Population limit" warning.
[*] Added achievement localizations.
[*] Additional bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Cities' bonuses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Opulent feasts: "Production growth" penalty replaced with "Growth of production in the forest".
[*] Homemade wine: doesn't raise the Culture Growth anymore; lowers "Growth of production in the forest" by 10% (was 20%).
[*] Skillful marble processing: lowers culture growth in temple by 15% (used to lower culture growth everywhere by 15%).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.01, renewed and updated
notes.notes:
The first update you tested is now officially released.
We tried to take into consideration everything you wrote to us and hope you will like this one!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]Events:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Defeating Persians raises relations with other Polises by 0.2 per turn (previously 0.05) for 10 turns.
[*] It is forbidden to cast away Romans with Roman legions.
[*] Roman Legions add 20K army (previously 100K).
[*] The Glory of Victory now gives Force of Army +10% to all cities (previously Sparta only got +2%).
[*] Conquering Rome quest now will not appear until Rome fell.
[*] Events that take the Army away now will not appear if the player has 0 armies.
[/list]

[h3]City bonuses:[/h3]
[b]Athens[/b]
[list]
[*] Cult of Sages and Oracles: Force of Army -20% (was -10%).
[*] Strong civilian reserves: Force of army +30% (was +20%).
[*] Love of freedom: Income and Production growth from tax collectors +30% (was +20%).
[*] Fertile soil: Farming efficiency +20% (was +10%).
[*] Skillful marble processing: Culture growth -15% (was -20%).
[/list]

[b]Corinth[/b]
[list]
[*] Homemade wine: Culture growth +20% (was +10%).
[*] Cheap mercenaries: The cost of buying the military is 40% lower (was 30%).
[/list]

[h3]Techs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tactical formations 1 raises the force of the army by 20% (was 10%).
[*] Logistics 1 and 2 - raises fleet production efficiency in Harbor by 35% (was 25% and + fleet limit)
[*] Mercenary 1 raises Force of Army by 20% (instead of "selling army is more profitable by 20%").
[*] Mercenary 2 raises buying army efficiency by 30% (was 20%) and raises Force of Army by 30% (instead of "selling army is more profitable by 20%").
[*] Wood processing 1 now also raises Force of Army by 20%.
[/list]

[h3]Buildings:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corinth: all army buildings raise Army limits and max workers more by 20%.
[/list]

[h3]Cities:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Miletus spawns on turn 130 (was 140).
[*] Sparta: trade bonus raises buying army efficiency by 30% (was 20%).
[*] Knoss', Larissa's and Sparta's starting stats are higher now for Corinth players.
[*] All of the world map cities' prices raised.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug with Traders tooltip disappearing from the trade window.
[*] Fixed the bug with several regions on the map being shown as chosen at the same time.
[*] Loading proper saves bug fixed.
[*] Rounding of gold in stat panel and tooltip fixed.
[*] Fixed the bug where Cordoba spawning introduced an error in the log.
[*] Fixed the bug that triggers Greece Unification only the turn after all of the conditions were met.
[*] Fixed troubles with running the game on Ubuntu from Steam.
[*] Fixed negative fleet number being used in the Trade window.
[*] Fixed the color of Requirements in the colony panel.
[*] Save compatibility is improved.
[*] Fixed the bug with the "Trading breakthrough" event appearing prematurely.
[*] Fixed the bug with players not getting bonus relations with Corinth after defeating Dorians.
[*] Fixed the end game score counting.
[*] Fixed The Glory of Victory effect showing in battle screen even if not applied.
[*] Fixed the bug with disappearing Corinth Walls.
[*] Buying out the city now will end the "Revenge" event.
[*] Fixed the Cheap mercenaries bonus for Corinth (used to bring less army from trading instead of more).
[/list]

[h3]Misc:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Credits are updated with proper names for testers.
[*] It is now possible to scout and settle regions with a double-click.
[*] Now you can Trade or Raid by double-clicking on the according to resource.
[*] Text corrections.
[/list]

Marble Age: Remastered is out! What now?

Questions and comments are welcome! :)

notes.title: Marble Age: Remastered is out now!
notes.notes:
Situated in Ancient Greece, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383740/Marble_Age_Remastered/]Marble Age Remastered [/url]lets you explore its early history through one of three famous Greek city-states: Athens, Corinth, or Sparta. The game covers over 3000 years of history of Ancient Greece, starting from the earliest prehistoric settlements to the creation of the cross-continental Empire.

Each polis has unique gameplay, where Athens relies on its excellent diplomacy, Sparta on its powerful army, and Corinth on its endless money. Choose your polis and see if you can conquer the world!

[h3]Athens - Diplomacy[/h3]
Diplomacy is Athens' main power. Send the envoys to every part of the world and form alliances even with the most stubborn enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38866518/3d843138076f71f71f8e8e82c8c8b7bc41edf4d0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Sparta - Military[/h3]
Spartan warriors fought to win. No polis in Hellas will be able to withhold their onslaught!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38866518/1c73f99410950336fa75410adf7d6b6c4094937e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Corinth - Trade[/h3]
There is nothing money can't buy, they say. If you agree, then Corinth is your choice. Will you be able to earn enough to buy the world?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38866518/633fa2f63dffb3aa77ccc14a925f24136ee72186.jpg[/img]

Choose your city and let history unfold in front of your eyes!

notes.title: Marble Age: Remastered
notes.notes:
Situated in Ancient Greece, [b]Marble Age: Remastered[/b] lets players explore its early history through one of three famous Greek city-states: Athens, Corinth, or Sparta. In addition to the original two poleis — Athens and Sparta, newly added content allows players to explore Corinth — a wealthy luxurious polis strategically located at the crossroad of trading paths. Each city has unique gameplay, where Athens relies on its excellent diplomacy, Sparta on its powerful army, and Corinth on its endless money. The game covers over 3000 years of history of Ancient Greece, starting from the earliest prehistoric settlements to the creation of the cross-continental Empire.

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Experience Ancient Greece from the POV of 3 different cities - Athens, Sparta, or Corinth
[*] Overcome ten real historical challenges, from the Dorian Invasion to the Unification of Europe!
[*] Wisely manage your resources to make the most of them!
[*] Explore, Expand, Exploit, Exterminate — Marble Age is a bite-sized 4X strategy, available for nearly any PC!
[/list]

notes.title: Marble Age: Remastered - Full Game for Corinth
notes.notes:
At last! Today our lead game designer Mikhail will present you the newest addition to the Marble Age: Remastered - the polis of Corinth! Corinth is a trading city, located at the crossroad of the main trading paths of Ancient Greece. While playing for Corinth, the best way to conquer the enemies is to buy them all. Will we succeed tonight? Tune in to watch!
